amenitiesDescription:
THE WELL Coconut Grove delivers two distinct amenity tiers — one exclusively for residents, one shared with THE WELL Club members — anchored by a 40,000 SF rooftop wellness oasis and a 13,000 SF ground-level Wellness Club. The rooftop features two pools, a hot and cold plunge, private cabanas, a Fitness Forest, pickleball court, and an outdoor dining terrace. The Wellness Club includes a state-of-the-art fitness center, a mindful movement studio with aerial yoga and a healing gong wall, a communal bathhouse with steam, sauna, cold plunge, and caldarium, hyperbaric chambers, a crystal cave relaxation lounge, and private treatment rooms.

The resident-exclusive Conservatory — a double-height glass indoor-outdoor space — overlooks the tea garden with a reflection pond and hosts co-working, IV therapy, and a Shiftwave Recovery Chair. Additional programming includes bi-annual health coaching, annual whole-person health assessments, THE WELL Locker (Theragun, infrared blankets, lymph boots, FaceWare Pro), an aperitif bar, and an energy-clearing ceremony for every new residence upon move-in.

signals.title: The Well — wellness brand's first residential venture
signals.body: The Well operates acclaimed wellness clubs in NYC, Bridgehampton, and globally. This is the brand's first residential address. Wellness-branded properties have emerged as the most differentiated new category in Miami luxury real estate.

signals.title: Only new luxury condo launching in Coconut Grove
signals.body: At Park Grove and Grove at Grand Bay, owners routinely decline offers 30–40% above purchase price — and with no competing new supply, The Well enters a market primed for absorption.

signals.title: Coconut Grove: Miami's most resilient luxury micro-market
signals.body: Grove luxury condos appreciate steadily even in down years for the broader Miami market. The buyer base is primarily end-users — families, primary residents — not investors, which means lower inventory volatility and stronger price support.

signals.title: Full wellness programming included for residents
signals.body: Medical wellness, spa, fitness, nutrition, and recovery programming built into the residential offering. This model commands premium rents from health-conscious long-term tenants and premium prices from buyers who live the wellness lifestyle.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: The Well enters the most supply-constrained neighborhood in Miami with a brand story that resonates precisely with the buyer demographic that calls Coconut Grove home. Grove buyers are primary-residence purchasers — they hold, they don't flip — which is why Park Grove resale prices reached 100% above original developer pricing. The Well's wellness differentiation creates a moat within this already moat-protected market.

investmentThesis: 50% sold. THE WELL brand's first fully integrated residential community, backed by Terra's development track record (Five Park Miami Beach, Villa Miami, Jean-Georges Miami Tropic). The WELL concept has a proven, affluent membership base that creates a built-in buyer pipeline. The dual-tier amenity model — private residential amenities plus a shared Wellness Club — generates revenue that supports building operations while giving residents access to programming that would be cost-prohibitive in a standalone residential building. Delivery targeted Q4 2028.
name: THE WELL Coconut Grove
parking: 382 parking spaces; valet, 24-hour security, EV charging stations
residenceContent: Miami's first new development to fully integrate the WELL brand into residential living — a boutique community where wellness is engineered into the building itself, not just offered as an amenity. The distinctive coral stone facade honors Coconut Grove's architectural heritage while softly curved, nature-immersed interiors reflect the neighborhood's tropical character. Residences from one to four bedrooms feature 10-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass, European oak flooring, Italian stone bathrooms, custom Arclinea kitchens with Miele appliances, private terraces, and pre-wired smart home systems. The building holds Florida Green Building Design Silver Certification. Located steps from Coconut Grove's dining, boutiques, parks, and bayfront.
